items.exampleEn: My brother eats crisps while he watches TV.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟邊看電視邊吃洋芋片。

items.exampleEn: We had sausages and eggs for breakfast.
items.exampleZh: 我們早餐吃了香腸和蛋。

items.exampleEn: The first batch of bread is ready.
Dad made grilled corn at the barbecue.
items.exampleZh: 爸爸在烤肉時做了烤玉米。

items.exampleEn: There's a napkin under your fork.
items.exampleZh: 你的叉子下面有一張餐巾紙。

items.exampleEn: My uncle roasts coffee beans in his shop.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔在他的店裡烘焙咖啡豆。

items.sentenceEn: Please put a napkin next to each plate.
items.sentenceZh: 請在每個盤子旁邊放一張餐巾紙。

items.audioEn: Mom roasted a chicken, and Dad grilled some sausages.
items.audioZh: 媽媽烤了一隻雞，爸爸烤了一些香腸。

items.sentenceEn: These pears are from my uncle's farm.
items.sentenceZh: 這些梨子是我叔叔農場種的。

items.sentenceEn: Have some crisps with your sandwich.
items.sentenceZh: 吃三明治配點洋芋片吧。

items.stemEn: Do you want some ____? They're from the fruit shop.
items.stemZh: 你要不要吃點梨子？是在水果店買的。

items.stemEn: She made a big ____ of cookies.

items.passageEn: For Dad's birthday, we had a party in the garden. Mom roasted a chicken in the oven, and my older brother grilled sausages outside. I baked a batch of chocolate cookies. We also had fresh pears and a few bags of crisps. Everyone ate with their hands, so we needed a lot of napkins!
items.passageZh: 爸爸生日那天，我們在花園辦了一場派對。媽媽用烤箱烤了一隻雞，哥哥在外面烤香腸。我烤了一批巧克力餅乾。我們還準備了新鮮的梨子和幾包洋芋片。大家都用手拿東西吃，所以需要很多餐巾紙！

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼需要很多餐巾紙？
options: 有人把飲料打翻在桌上

items.promptZh: 我想要烤雞和一份沙拉。
referenceEn: I'd like grilled chicken and a salad.
Can I have grilled chicken and a salad, please?
rubricZh: 「烤雞」可寫例如 grilled chicken、roast chicken
點餐可寫例如 I'd like…、Can I have…?

items.instructionZh: 用 roast 造一個句子，說說你家裡會在什麼時候烤什麼。
referenceEn: My father roasts sweet potatoes in winter.
We roast meat in the oven on weekends.
rubricZh: roast 是動詞「烤」（例如 roast a chicken、roasts sweet potatoes）
主詞第三人稱單數時動詞加 s（例如 roasts）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似詞義選擇：crisp 以英式名詞 crisps（洋芋片）示範；若 CEFR-J A2 的 crisp 是形容詞「脆的」，則與已裁原則（該級詞性）不符，建議核對 lexicon 詞性後再定
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 不改：已核對 lexicon，crisp 只有名詞 A2（第③關也確認），維持名詞「洋芋片」
